BiblicalUsage: The name is Rohagah, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 7:34: "…the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rohagah counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
